reason_consistency.name: reason_consistency
reason_consistency.summary: 302 citations from 300 ledger entries (127 skipped as code-generated gate reasons): 91.7% consistent, 5.9% contradicted, 2.4% weak, 103 unscored (considered verdict), 7 abstained as concessive constructions, 23 abstained as advertiser-described terms (coverage_rate=0.560: scored citations / all citations found — abstention is deliberate, precision is prioritized over recall). 5.2% of checkable reasons cited nothing in the phrase map (vague).
